title: Special management area boundary assessment
summary: A consultant said on July 14, 2026 that Maui's special management area (SMA), a protected coastal zone, has not changed since 1979. Findings on the Special Management Area (SMA) boundary are to be presented to the commission in July of next year. The review stems from a $250,000 shoreline boundary study that Planning said in April 2025 would go out for bids and give recommendations to the Maui Planning Commission.
